# U182: Defining and baselines: as Rhea, Flaky test rate’s form shows it as a ratio with its numerator and denominator, says “To reach Defined, still needed: 1 of 10” (the link), and pasting the link and saving makes it Defined; as Marisol, adding a Build & Release baseline to Change failure rate lists it beside the company’s, still Verified; as Daniel in a quarter’s first week, Home says 1 of his metrics has no baseline for Oct–Dec, and Take this quarter’s baselines fills CI pipeline time from its source and saves it for Jul–Sep 2026

- **Belongs to:** the Metric library module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `METRIC-STAGE`, `METRIC-BASELINES`
- **Budget:** at most 12 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/metrics/flaky-rate/edit` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U182

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/metrics/flaky-rate/edit` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Still needed” part (`[data-part="Still needed"]`) is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** “To reach Defined, still needed: 1 of 10” is shown in the “Still needed” part (`[data-part="Still needed"]`) (else: the form does not count what is still needed).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `(await p.getByRole('button', { name: /^Ratio/ }).getAttribute('aria-pressed')) === 'true' && (await p.getByLabel('Numerator: Counts').inputValue()).length > 5`. Else it says: the form does not show the ratio and its numerator.
- **Step.** Type “https://ci-analytics.example.com/tests/flaky-rate” into the “Link to the report or query” field.
- **Check:** “All 10 parts are said” is shown in the “Still needed” part (`[data-part="Still needed"]`) (else: the box does not say every part is said once the link is in).
- **Step.** Press the “Save changes” button.
- If a dialog is there:
  - **Step.** Press the “(Change the source / Save these changes / Save changes)” button in a dialog.
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** “Defined” is shown in the metric top (`.metric-top`) (else: Flaky test rate is not Defined after the link was added).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “defined”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Marisol adds a team slice's baseline (journey 7): beside the company's, and the stage stays Verified.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `(k) => localStorage.setItem(k, 'marisol')`, given `'goals-app-viewer:platform-org'`.
- Go to `/metrics/cfr` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Add a baseline for a team” link.
- Find and pick: press “Slice”, type “build”, and choose “Build & Release”.
- **Step.** Type “9.4” into the “Value” field.
- **Step.** Type “Aug–Oct 2026” into the “Period it covers” field.
- **Step.** Type “Four Keys query, the team’s services” into the “How it was taken” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Add baseline” button.
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** “Build & Release” is shown in the “Baselines” part (`[data-part="Baselines"]`) (else: the team’s baseline is not listed).
- **Check:** “Company” is shown in the “Baselines” part (`[data-part="Baselines"]`) (else: the company’s baseline went).
- **Check:** “Verified” is shown in the metric top (`.metric-top`) (else: adding a baseline changed the stage).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “team baseline”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Daniel, in the first week of a quarter (journey 6): Home asks, and the readings fill the figure.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `(k) => localStorage.setItem(k, 'daniel')`, given `'goals-app-viewer:platform-org'`.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Monday 5 October 2026.
- **Check:** “1 of your metrics has no baseline for Oct–Dec” is shown in the “Baselines due” part (`[data-part="Baselines due"]`) (else: Home does not ask for this quarter’s baselines).
- **Step.** Press the “Take this quarter’s baselines” link in the “Baselines due” part (`[data-part="Baselines due"]`).
- **Check:** “Read from CI analytics” is shown in the metric take row (`.metric-take-row`) (else: the figure is not read from the source).
- **Step.** Press the “Confirm 1 baseline” button.
- **Check:** The address changes.

[]).find((m) => m.id === 'metric_ci-time')`; `const now = (ci?.baselines ?? []).find((b) => !b.replacedAt && !b.teamId)`. Else it says: CI pipeline time’s company baseline is {worked out in the journey as `now ? '${now.value} for ${now.period}' : 'missing'`}, read {read}.
